summary: iOS/iPadOS 16.4 Web Push is confirmed for Home Screen web apps; Android release support remains capability-tested until a vendor/version matrix is pinned.
Service workers are event-bounded and may be terminated, so the relay exclusively owns Pi execution, WSS continuity, and reconnect state.
Push is deduplicated from committed agent_settled, pending-approval, or indeterminate transitions and is suppressed for active visible clients.
Push contains only an opaque lookup and generic text; approval requires foreground reauthentication and live epoch/payload/policy/CAS validation.
Onboarding stages tailnet reachability, relay identity, PWA installation, then user-gesture notification consent.
Offline UX is a bounded redacted read-only snapshot; all mutations and approvals remain disabled until authenticated reconciliation.
MVP uses explicit session, thread/tool, approval, and connection surfaces with keyboard, focus, target-size, and coalesced-status accessibility invariants.
MVP scope is phased by verified authority and lifecycle behavior; device matrices and multi-device notification hardening follow, while public exposure remains exceptional.
Exact Android browser/OS web-push and Tailscale onboarding support was not directly verified; pin a tested release matrix in iteration 6.
Tailnet-hosted iOS Home Screen push, delayed notification activation, and stale-approval races require real-device validation.
